How can I use connection pools with shiny?

Bruno Sousa

messages.subject: Re: R shiny with connection pool
parts:
Hi Bruno,

I don't know whether or not connection pooling is easily available for MySQL in R, but Shiny wouldn't limit you in this. You would just want to make sure that your connection pool were properly scoped (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#scoping). i.e. you weren't setting up a new connection pool for every Shiny session, but rather had a global pool that was shared between all sessions.

Hopefully someone else can steer you in the right direction regarding MySQL connection pooling in R!

Jeff
